description: Everything an agent needs to write, gate, ship and debug .NET 10 and .NET 8 code the way the OCX family does: the csharp-quality rule (the gate block, the non-negotiables and twelve depth files on processes, binaries, async, API design, errors, JSON, platform and paths, testing and CI, the language era, security, observability and performance), the dotnet-build rule (SDK pin, central package management, the warnings-as-errors posture, the analyzer packs with their banned-symbol and severity files, restore hygiene and pack properties, and the workflows and build scripts that run them), plus the dotnet-upgrade skill that moves a solution from net8.0 to net10.0, the dotnet-diagnose skill for a failing restore, build, analyzer, trim, test or hang, and the dotnet-release skill that cuts a NuGet library or an application release. The code-docs rule and the code-docs-cleanup skill cover comments in every language: short blocks that keep every guard.
name: dotnet-essentials
summary: The OCX .NET set: C# source standards, the build, analyzer and package-file rule, and the upgrade, diagnosis and release procedures
